summary_en: Update to capital-cost and share-price conscious management framework. Specific metrics and targets not disclosed in header announcement; full details in attached materials.
title_en: Update on Measures Toward Realizing Capital-Cost and Share-Price Conscious Management
translation_en_brief: e-Seikatsu filed an update to its capital-cost and share-price conscious management framework on 22 June 2026. The announcement references a prior disclosure made on 23 June 2025 and states that the company has updated the content based on current analysis, evaluation, and progress of initiatives. The specific metrics, targets, and policy changes are detailed in attached materials and are not summarized in the announcement header itself.
